text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 20, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "pressed on the doorbell 20 times"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 0.25, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 10, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "10 times more than the fourth friend"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 60, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "the fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "the extra presses the second friend made, 1/4 more than the first friend's 20"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "second friend's total presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q4", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "third friend's total presses, 10 more than the fourth friend's 60"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "first plus second friend's presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s4", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "add the third friend's presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s5", "q4"], "out": "s6", "note": "add the fourth friend's presses to get the total doorbell rings"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the total number of times the doorbell rang from all four friends"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 4, "reason": "the number of friends who visited; each friend's individual press count is already used directly, so this count itself is not a separate operand"}]}
